title: 第5章 收徒徐洋浇水工具人第6章 深夜跟踪暗中勾结
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
“呵呵，一群愚蠢自大的人。”
“既然你们都不要，那我就笑纳了。”
看着一旁南宫烈等人的表演，李如风终于是不再继续观望下去。
就这样，没有去管沈星河这边，李如风起身朝着下方的徐洋走去。
“嗯？”
“是啊，我们在这里说半天，怎么把他给忘了。”
“宗主，飞仙宗除我们六大峰，不是还有他李如风的灵药峰吗？”
“我看那人去灵药峰，那是再合适不过。”
“毕竟只是照顾灵药这种事，炼气境的修为足够了。”
在发现了李如风的动静后，南宫烈顿时大声阴阳怪气道。
话音落下，其余人也是接连朝着李如风望去。
“唉，目前来看，这确实是最好的办法了。”
“行吧，你们都带着各自峰的新弟子回去吧。”
“这事，就不用你们操心了。”
经过南宫烈一番提醒，沈星河也是才想到还有李如风的灵药峰。
“我等告退。”
很快，南宫烈等人便相继带着人离开了宗门广场。
与此同时，李如风已经来到徐洋面前。
“少年，你渴望力量吗？”
看了几眼徐洋后，李如风突然开口问道。

“啊？”听到李如风的话，徐洋一时之间有些发懵，不太明白李如风的话中意思。
“字面意思，你就说你想要力量吗？”
“还是说，你想要一辈子都待在炼气九重？”
李如风淡淡开口道。
“我……”徐洋顿时有些犹豫起来。
“想清楚再说。”李如风的声音再次响起。
“想，我想要力量！”
“自从我的根基被毁，我无时无刻不在遭受他人的冷言冷语。”
“这种感觉，我受够了，也麻木了。”
“但我没办法，我只能忍受……”
说着说着，徐洋语气突然沉默下来，脸上露出满是不甘的神情。
“很好，只要你没有放弃，一切都好说。”
看到徐洋的反应，李如风满意的点了点头道。
紧接着，李如风开口道：“我有办法帮你变得更强。”
“只要你拜我为师即可。”
“当然，还有其他一些小小的要求。”
“不过这些等你做出选择后再细说。”
“现在，轮到你做出选择了。”
“少年，可愿拜我为师？”
李如风说完，便一脸平静的望着徐洋。

“您真的可以帮我变强？”
“若是这样，弟子见过师尊！”
徐洋二话不说，直接就是跪下给李如风行拜师礼。
content_en:
"Haha, a bunch of stupid and arrogant people."
"Since you don't want it, then I'll accept it."
Looking at the performance of Nangong Lie and others, Li Rufeng finally stopped watching.
Just like that, without paying attention to Shen Xinghe's side, Li Rufeng stood up and walked towards Xu Yang below.
"Huh?"
"Yeah, we've been talking here for a long time, how could we forget about him."
"Sect Master, besides our six major peaks, doesn't Feixian Sect also have Li Rufeng's elixir peak?"
"I think it would be perfect for that person to go to Spiritual Medicine Peak."
"After all, it's just a matter of taking care of the elixir. My cultivation in the Qi Refining Realm is enough."
After discovering Li Rufeng's movements, Nangong Lie suddenly said loudly and strangely.
After the words fell, the others looked at Li Rufeng one after another.
"Well, currently, this is indeed the best way."
"Okay, you all go back with the new disciples from your respective peaks."
"You don't need to worry about this."
After Nangong Lie's reminder, Shen Xinghe only thought of Li Rufeng's elixir peak.
"I'll take my leave."
Soon, Nangong Lie and others left the Zongmen Square one after another.
At the same time, Li Rufeng had arrived in front of Xu Yang.
"Young man, do you long for power?"
After looking at Xu Yang for a few times, Li Rufeng suddenly asked.
"Ah?" Hearing Li Rufeng's words, Xu Yang was confused for a moment and didn't quite understand what Li Rufeng meant.
"Literally, you just said you wanted power?"
"Or do you want to stay at the ninth level of Qi Refining for the rest of your life?"
Li Rufeng said calmly.
"I..." Xu Yang suddenly hesitated.
"Think it over before you speak." Li Rufeng's voice sounded again.
"Think, I want power!"
"Ever since my foundation was destroyed, I have been subjected to sarcastic remarks from others all the time."
"I've had enough of this feeling and I'm numb."
"But I can't help it, I can only endure it..."
As he spoke, Xu Yang suddenly became silent, with a look of reluctance on his face.
"Very well, as long as you don't give up, everything is easy."
Seeing Xu Yang's reaction, Li Rufeng nodded with satisfaction.
Then, Li Rufeng said: "I have a way to help you become stronger."
"As long as you worship me as your teacher."
"Of course, there are other small requests."
“But we’ll discuss these in detail after you make your choice.”
"Now, it's your turn to make a choice."
"Young man, are you willing to become your teacher?"
After Li Rufeng finished speaking, he looked at Xu Yang calmly.
"Can you really help me become stronger?"
"If this is the case, this disciple has met the master!"
Xu Yang didn't say anything, and just knelt down to perform the apprenticeship ceremony for Li Rufeng.
